liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alligator** (2 reviews, 1 other source): The Alligator reprise has Mountain Jam licks around the five-minute mark; Reviewer singles out Alligator as especially enjoyable [1][15][16]
- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Schoolgirl as excellent; Reviewer calls this the best Schoolgirl they have heard [5][6]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): The Eleven shows remarkable band chemistry, which the reviewer finds almost spiritual [16]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (1 other source): A splice or tape flip occurs at 3:45 in this song [2]

## The recordings

- **gd1968-08-21.sbd.cousinit.17689.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 118 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Nearly all of Cryptical Envelopment on track 1 is missing, and the start of Dark Star is cut. Digital errors exist on the source DAT [1]
- **gd68-08-21.sbd.cotsman.17355.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 111 min; rated 4.47/5 by 49 [2]. Said about its sound: Garcia's guitar tone is captured vividly, with audible tube crunch and reverb slapback from his amp; Garcia's guitar tone is exceptional, though the recording has some hiss; The first two tracks are only short excerpts of larger pieces [2][5][6][10][11][12][13][15]
- **gd1968-08-21.sbd.unknown.1183.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 125 min; rated 4.12/5 by 8 [3]
- **gd1968-08-21.139746.sbd.MasterReel.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.pcfix.t-flac1644**: soundboard; 9 songs; 111 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [4]

## Around the show

- Phil Lesh plays wildly all over the place, moving alongside Jerry in the space section [14]
- The four-show run from 8/21 to 8/24 is called unbeatable for 1968; this show and 8/24 rank in reviewer's top five [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1968-08-21.sbd.cousinit.17689.shnf**: transferred by DAT>SHN conversion by Cousinit; source: MSR>DAT>DAT>WAV>SHN [1]
- **gd68-08-21.sbd.cotsman.17355.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Teeple and Dave Litfin; source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1968-08-21.sbd.unknown.1183.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: sdb>>reel master>>cassette>>dat>>cdr [3]
- **gd1968-08-21.139746.sbd.MasterReel.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.pcfix.t-flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reels > Dat; Charlie Miller [4]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Nate Gonzalez (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead: August 21 1968](https://www.flickr.com/photos/43741514@N00/5465346963/) [18]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/43741514@N00/5465346963/) [19]
